T.label: Primary Tumor (pathological pT family; T1-T3 cannot be assigned clinically)

categories.description: Pathological: primary tumor cannot be assessed
Pathological: no evidence of primary tumor
Pathological: germ cell neoplasia in situ
Pathological: tumor limited to testis (including rete testis invasion) without lymphovascular invasion (parent for pT1a/pT1b)
Pathological: tumor smaller than 3 cm in size (pure seminoma only)
Pathological: tumor 3 cm or larger in size (pure seminoma only)

Pathological: tumor limited to testis (including rete testis invasion) with lymphovascular invasion OR tumor invading hilar soft tissue or epididymis or penetrating visceral mesothelial layer covering the external surface of tunica albuginea with or without lymphovascular invasion
Pathological: tumor directly invades spermatic cord soft tissue with or without lymphovascular invasion
Pathological: tumor invades scrotum with or without lymphovascular invasion

notes.pt1_seminoma_only: Subclassification of pT1 (pT1a/pT1b) applies only to pure seminoma.
notes.clinical_t: Clinical T is restricted to cTX (cannot be assessed), cT0 (no evidence), cTis (germ cell neoplasia in situ), and cT4 (tumor invades scrotum with or without vascular/lymphatic invasion). T1-T3 require radical orchiectomy. Except for Tis confirmed by biopsy and T4, the extent of the primary tumor is classified by radical orchiectomy; TX may be used for other categories for clinical staging.

categories.description: Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed
No regional lymph node metastasis
Metastasis with a lymph node mass 2 cm or smaller in greatest dimension and less than or equal to five nodes positive, none larger than 2 cm in greatest dimension

Metastasis with a lymph node mass larger than 2 cm but not larger than 5 cm in greatest dimension; or more than five nodes positive, none larger than 5 cm; or evidence of extranodal extension of tumor
Metastasis with a lymph node mass larger than 5 cm in greatest dimension

notes.clinical_n: Clinical cN uses the same size thresholds but counts mass (no node count requirement): cN1 lymph node mass 2 cm or smaller OR multiple lymph nodes, none > 2 cm; cN2 mass > 2 cm but not > 5 cm OR multiple nodes, any mass > 2 cm but none > 5 cm; cN3 mass > 5 cm.

categories.description: No distant metastasis
Distant metastasis present (parent for M1a/M1b)
Non-retroperitoneal nodal or pulmonary metastases
Non-pulmonary visceral metastases
Marker studies not available or not performed
Marker study levels within normal limits
LDH less than 1.5 x N AND hCG (mIU/mL) less than 5,000 AND AFP (ng/mL) less than 1,000
LDH 1.5-10 x N OR hCG (mIU/mL) 5,000-50,000 OR AFP (ng/mL) 1,000-10,000
LDH greater than 10 x N OR hCG (mIU/mL) greater than 50,000 OR AFP (ng/mL) greater than 10,000

notes.n_is_upper_limit: N indicates the upper limit of normal for the LDH assay.

categories.description: Clinical classification (cTNM). For testis, cT is limited to cTX/cT0/cTis/cT4; T1-T3 require pathological staging.
Pathological classification (pTNM). Required for definitive T1-T4 staging following radical orchiectomy.

notes.matching: AJCC 8 testis has both a clinical (cTNM) and a pathological (pTNM) stage group table. This model uses pT-prefixed T values; the Classification axis is kept for parity with other organ models and is not used by the rule lookup.
